title: Native media and timing contract
summary: The native worker consumes pre-staged planar YUV420P video at 1280 × 720, 24 frames/s and signed 16-bit little-endian stereo PCM at 48,000 samples/s; 2,000 stereo sample frames accompany each video frame.
invariants: Audio bytes per frame are 2,000 sample frames × 2 channels × 2 bytes = 8,000.
Use monotonic clock scheduling for playout; wall-clock and civil-time conversion belong outside the frame loop.
Staging FFmpeg is an offline input adapter, not the device-owning resident engine.
Video and audio outputs are separate browser capture devices: V4L2 camera and PipeWire/PulseAudio microphone.
procedure: Retain fixed output format through scene changes.
For new audio formats, resample prior to admission or extend the native provider with explicit qualification.
Instrument timestamp skew and device back-pressure on the real openSUSE host; offline byte equality cannot establish live A/V synchronisation.

provenance.claim: Frame and PCM constants, output writing and pacing.
Precise media and live-host dependency contract.
